tools.name: sosoapi_get_user_profile
tools.description: Read the signed-in user's own profile (display name, timezone, avatar, theme); profile is null until one exists.

include_version.description: Optional. true adds the resource version to the answer.

tools.name: sosoapi_update_user_profile
tools.description: Change the signed-in user's own profile (display_name, timezone, avatar_url, theme). Send only the fields to change.

expected_version.description: Optional. The version you read. If it changed since, the update fails with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT instead of overwriting.

include_version.description: Optional. true adds the resource version to the answer.

tools.name: sosoapi_sign_avatar_upload
tools.description: Get a signed URL for uploading a new avatar image for the signed-in user (filename and content_type required). Does not change the profile by itself.

byte_size.description: Exact avatar size in bytes (max 5 MiB); signed into the upload URL

tools.name: sosoapi_list_api_keys
tools.description: List the user's API keys (name, last 4 characters, status, expiry, lineage); set include_authority to also get each key's capabilities and Workspace limit. Secrets are never returned. Needs the Manage API keys grant; a PAT cannot use it.

authority_view.description: Opt into full effective_capabilities. Existing capabilities fields remain the frozen legacy-v1 display projection; this grants no new authority.

include_authority.description: Return legacy-v1 capabilities, Workspace limit (null = every Workspace) and creator grant. Use authority_view: effective-v2 for full capabilities; scopes always retains full authority.

page.description: Opt into bounded pagination, status counts and complete direct rotation lineage. When present, page.status controls revoked visibility instead of include_revoked.

search.description: Literal case-insensitive search of the key name or masked last four characters.

tools.name: sosoapi_create_api_key
tools.description: Create a PAT; its secret is returned once. Human lifetime is up to 365 days; delegated up to 30 days and never past its grant. Choose capabilities/workspace_ids; agent:research is separate opt-in, omitted capabilities keep legacy defaults. Agents can grant only held capabilities. Requires Manage API keys consent; PATs cannot issue keys.

lifetime_days.description: Days until the key expires (1-365, default 365). A key created by a delegated agent never lives longer than 30 days.

capabilities.description: What the key may do. Defaults to operate, publish and engage for a signed-in user. Research and Listening require explicit agent:research opt-in. A delegated agent can only grant what its own authorization holds (never key management), and omitted capabilities never add research.

workspace_ids.description: Limit the key to these Workspaces. Omit it for every Workspace the user can access. A limited key must name its Workspace (workspace_id) on routes that would otherwise use the active Workspace, and cannot call organization-wide reads.

scopes.description: Deprecated alias of capabilities. It is honoured exactly; an empty list is ignored.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key to retry safely. The secret is shown once: a retry that finds the key already created answers 409 IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY (details.existing_key names it) instead of showing it again. Revoke that key and create a new one with a new idempotency_key.

tools.name: sosoapi_extend_api_key
tools.description: Set a later expiry (expires_at) on an API key identified by id: at most 365 days from now, or 30 for a key an agent created. An agent can extend only keys its own grant created. Needs the Manage API keys grant.

expires_at.description: Requested new absolute expiry. The longest lifetime is 365 days from now, or 30 days for a key created by a delegated agent. A signed-in person extending their own key is granted that longest lifetime when they ask for a later time (up to 3,650 days from now); in every other case a later time is refused with API_KEY_LIFETIME_EXCEEDS_CAP. The response carries the expiry actually applied.

tools.name: sosoapi_renew_api_key
tools.description: Create a successor for an API key (id) with a new secret returned once and the same capabilities and Workspace limit, optionally a new name or lifetime (365 days at most, 30 for an agent-created key). The original key is not revoked. Needs the Manage API keys grant.

lifetime_days.description: Days until the successor expires (1-365, default 365; 30 at most for a key created by a delegated agent). The successor keeps the predecessor's capabilities and Workspace limit.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key to retry safely. The new secret is shown once: a retry that finds the successor already created answers 409 IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY (details.existing_key names it). Revoke it and renew again with a new idempotency_key.

tools.name: sosoapi_revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke an API key by id so it stops working immediately; an already-revoked key reports already_revoked. An agent can revoke only keys its own grant created. Needs the Manage API keys grant.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_billing_status
tools.description: Read the user's billing plan, payment state, current cycle dates and quota usage (successful publishes, pending scheduled posts, connected accounts). Check it before large scheduling runs.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_organization_billing
tools.description: Read actual Organization plan, invoice-derived pricing and pending changes under the selected Workspace and current Organization Owner authority. This cannot claim an offer or change billing.

include_offer.description: Read retained promotional eligibility and claim facts without claiming an offer.

checkout_operation_id.description: Read a retained accepted quote for this actor and Organization; never retrieve its bearer URL or confirm payment.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_commercial_access
tools.description: Read plan and quota facts for one Workspace's billing account, plus its commercial_access_mode (off, shadow or enforce).

tools.name: sosoapi_get_organization_context
tools.description: Read the live map of your Organizations, their Workspaces and Channels with ids and roles. Use it when Organization or Channel ids are needed. For Workspace posting, reuse a returned Workspace id; do not also read workspace context.

tools.name: sosoapi_create_workspace
tools.description: Create a Workspace in an Organization you own or administer. Pass organization_id when you belong to multiple Organizations. Use the returned id for your next calls: do not assume the new Workspace becomes the active one.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key to retry safely: a retry returns the original result instead of acting twice.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_workspace_context
tools.description: List the Workspaces the signed-in user belongs to and which one is active. Use this when workspace_id is unknown; reuse live context instead of repeating both context reads. The active Workspace it reports is the selection a person made in the web app, not a default for your calls: pass workspace_id explicitly. It is not purely a read: for an account with no Workspace it creates the first one.

include_version.description: Optional. true adds the resource version to the answer.

tools.name: sosoapi_update_workspace
tools.description: Rename a Workspace or change its slug. Workspace owner only.

expected_version.description: Optional. The version you read. If it changed since, the update fails with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT instead of overwriting.

include_version.description: Optional. true adds the resource version to the answer.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_organizations
tools.description: List the Organizations the signed-in user belongs to, with the ids that Organization-scoped tools take as organization_id.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_organization_connections
tools.description: List an Organization's provider connections (Meta, Instagram, Threads, YouTube) and their status. Needs organization_id.

tools.name: sosoapi_review_organization_connection
tools.description: Read the provider accounts and pages discovered by one pending connection operation (operation_id) so they can be reviewed. Read-only: a human confirms the connection in the web app.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_organization_channels
tools.description: List an Organization's channels (connected provider accounts) and which Workspace each is attached to.

tools.name: sosoapi_preview_organization_channel_move
tools.description: Dry run: check whether a channel can move to another Workspace and list what blocks it. Changes nothing.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_workspace_members
tools.description: List a Workspace's members and its pending invitations.

tools.name: sosoapi_submit_feedback
tools.description: Send product feedback (type bug, feature or general; up to 4,000 characters) to the SosoAPI team on the user's behalf. Use only when the user asks.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key to retry safely: a retry returns the original result instead of acting twice.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_notification_preferences
tools.description: Read the user's notification settings (currently whether an email is sent when a post fails).

tools.name: sosoapi_update_notification_preferences
tools.description: Change the user's notification settings (email_post_failed on or off).

tools.name: sosoapi_list_inbox_notifications
tools.description: Read the user's in-app inbox, newest first (up to 50), optionally only unread or of one kind.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_connected_accounts
tools.description: List the social accounts (Instagram, Threads, Facebook, YouTube) connected to a Workspace, with connection health and capability facts. Use their ids as social_account_id when scheduling or commenting. Pass workspace_id: a request without it is refused once explicit targeting is enforced.

tools.name: sosoapi_disconnect_social_account
tools.description: Disconnect a social account from its Workspace (Workspace owner only). Publishing to it stops until a human reconnects it with `sosoapi connect`.

tools.name: sosoapi_set_social_account_auto_sync
tools.description: Turn automatic sync on or off for one connected social account (editor role). Publishes nothing.

tools.name: sosoapi_clear_social_account_block
tools.description: Clear a provider cooldown on an account so publishing can resume. It does not retry any failed post; use sosoapi_retry_scheduled_post for that.

tools.name: sosoapi_query_assets
tools.description: Find a Workspace's assets by asset_type, source or tag; returns a page (limit up to 100, plus offset) and the total. Pass workspace_id explicitly.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Served up to 100000; beyond it 400 OFFSET_TOO_LARGE. Prefer filters to paging deep.

include_version.description: Optional. true adds the resource version to the answer.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_asset
tools.description: Read one asset by id: metadata and a short-lived preview URL.

include_version.description: Optional. true adds the resource version to the answer.

tools.name: sosoapi_create_asset
tools.description: Register an asset record for media or text you already host (asset_url, asset_type). It uploads nothing: use sosoapi_upload_asset for a local file or sosoapi_import_asset_url to have SosoAPI fetch a public URL. Pass workspace_id (refused without it once explicit targeting is enforced). Optional idempotency_key.

s0.description: Free-form JSON object; its serialized UTF-8 size must not exceed 16384 bytes.

tools.name: sosoapi_update_asset
tools.description: Change an asset's title, description or tags (editor role).

expected_version.description: Optional. The version you read. If it changed since, the update fails with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT instead of overwriting.

include_version.description: Optional. true adds the resource version to the answer.

tools.name: sosoapi_delete_asset
tools.description: Delete one asset from the Workspace library by id. Workspace owner only.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_assets
tools.description: List a Workspace's assets filtered by kind (video, image, audio, cover, thumbnail, frame, video-source, branding) or customer_ready_only, with next_offset paging. workspace_id is required.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Served up to 100000; beyond it 400 OFFSET_TOO_LARGE.

tools.name: sosoapi_import_asset_url
tools.description: Ask SosoAPI to download a public http(s) image or video URL into private Workspace storage as a new asset. Returns an import_id; poll sosoapi_get_asset_import_status. Needs an idempotency_key and the editor role.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_asset_import_status
tools.description: Read an import by import_id. For posting pass include_asset=true: a ready result includes the registered asset id, kind and stable asset_url, avoiding a separate get_asset. Pending or missing assets cannot be scheduled. Never use the source or preview URL as media identity. If stalled, read sosoapi_job_status with job_id; never start a duplicate import.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_orphan_assets
tools.description: List stored objects in a Workspace that no asset record points to (storage clean-up), paged by continuation token. Workspace owner only.

tools.name: sosoapi_delete_orphan_assets
tools.description: Delete selected unregistered storage objects by key. Workspace owner only; list them first with sosoapi_list_orphan_assets.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_asset_storage_inventory
tools.description: Read a paged inventory of a Workspace's registered assets and stored objects to audit storage.

tools.name: sosoapi_create_asset_export
tools.description: Export selected assets (asset_ids) as a manifest. Mode export_verify_then_purge prepares them for a later purge. Optional idempotency_key.

tools.name: sosoapi_verify_asset_export
tools.description: Start verifying an asset export (export_id). An export must be verified before a purge can be requested.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_asset_export_status
tools.description: Read an asset export's status: exported, verification_required, verifying, verified or failed.

tools.name: sosoapi_request_asset_purge
tools.description: Request permanent deletion of the stored bytes of assets covered by a verified export (export_id, asset_ids; confirm_history_loss may be required). Workspace owner only; irreversible once deleted.

tools.name: sosoapi_retry_asset_purge
tools.description: Retry a purge request that stopped (purge_request_id). Workspace owner only.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_projects
tools.description: List a Workspace's projects (an optional layer for provenance and account defaults) and which one is active.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100. Sending limit or cursor switches this route to cursor paging and adds next_cursor to the answer.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor: the next_cursor of the previous page, unchanged. Omit it for the first page. The same filters must be sent with every page.

include_version.description: Optional. true adds the resource version to the answer.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_project
tools.description: Read one project by id: name, lifecycle state, and the lifecycle and defaults versions later writes need.

include_version.description: Optional. true adds the resource version to the answer.

tools.name: sosoapi_create_project
tools.description: Create a project in a Workspace. Workspace owner only; optional idempotency_key.

tools.name: sosoapi_update_project
tools.description: Rename a project (its name is the only editable field). Workspace owner only.

expected_version.description: Optional. The version you read. If it changed since, the update fails with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT instead of overwriting.

include_version.description: Optional. true adds the resource version to the answer.

tools.name: sosoapi_set_active_project
tools.description: Set which project is the user's active one (a server-side default).

tools.name: sosoapi_get_project_account_defaults
tools.description: Read a project's default social accounts and per-account overrides, with the defaults_version the next replace needs.

tools.name: sosoapi_replace_project_account_defaults
tools.description: Replace a project's default accounts and overrides in one step. Needs expected_defaults_version from the latest read and an idempotency_key (editor role).

tools.name: sosoapi_archive_project
tools.description: Archive a project; schedules tied to it are held (held_schedule_count). Owner only; needs expected_lifecycle_version and an idempotency_key. Undo with sosoapi_unarchive_project.

tools.name: sosoapi_unarchive_project
tools.description: Reactivate an archived project; held schedules resume or need rescheduling. Owner only; needs expected_lifecycle_version and an idempotency_key.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_project_lifecycle_history
tools.description: Read a project's lifecycle events (such as archive and unarchive), up to 200.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_project_profile
tools.description: Read a project's brand profile (tagline, voice, target audience, goals, palette and more); profile is null when none exists.

tools.name: sosoapi_update_project_profile
tools.description: Patch a project's brand profile fields. Fields you omit stay unchanged. Needs expected_profile_version from the latest read and an idempotency_key (editor role).

tools.name: sosoapi_list_project_assets
tools.description: List the assets linked to a project with each link's relationship (identity, source or reference), paged by cursor.

tools.name: sosoapi_link_project_asset
tools.description: Link an existing asset to a project as identity, source or reference. Editor role; idempotency_key required.

tools.name: sosoapi_unlink_project_asset
tools.description: Remove an asset's link to a project; the asset itself is kept. idempotency_key required.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_project_accounts
tools.description: List the social accounts linked to a project, paged by cursor.

tools.name: sosoapi_link_project_account
tools.description: Link a connected social account to a project. Editor role; idempotency_key required.

tools.name: sosoapi_unlink_project_account
tools.description: Remove a social account's link to a project; the account stays connected. idempotency_key required.

tools.name: sosoapi_create_project_export
tools.description: Start an export of a project (Workspace owner only); poll sosoapi_get_project_export_status for the download URL. idempotency_key required.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_project_export_status
tools.description: Read a project export (export_id): queued, processing, completed (with a short-lived download URL) or failed. Workspace owner only.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_publication_attentions
tools.description: List publications in a Workspace that need attention, filtered by status (open or resolved) or scheduled_post_id, paged by offset.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_threads_sequences
tools.description: List saved Workspace Threads sequences, cursor-paged; never schedules or calls a provider.

tools.name: sosoapi_save_threads_sequence
tools.description: Save 2–25 ordered Threads Drafts with stable item ids and revision checks; creates no Posts.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_threads_sequence
tools.description: Reopen one Threads sequence by id with Draft revisions, Post outcomes and allowed actions.

tools.name: sosoapi_preview_threads_sequence
tools.description: Check saved sequence eligibility and reply capability; return a version-bound admission digest.

tools.name: sosoapi_create_threads_sequence
tools.description: Atomically admit a previewed sequence with its digest and versions. Accepted is not published.

tools.name: sosoapi_resume_threads_sequence
tools.description: Retry a safe failed suffix with exact group/Post versions; never resend published or uncertain items.

tools.name: sosoapi_cancel_threads_sequence
tools.description: Cancel unpublished sequence work with exact versions; preserve Drafts, accepted ids and published content.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_threads_content_queues
tools.description: List Workspace Threads queues, cursor-paged, with pause state and pending counts; never allocates.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_threads_content_queue
tools.description: Read one Threads queue by id: weekly slots, pending Draft revisions and allocation receipts.

tools.name: sosoapi_save_threads_content_queue
tools.description: Save versioned slots, pause state and pending Draft ids. Pausing preserves accepted schedules.

tools.name: sosoapi_delete_threads_content_queue
tools.description: Soft-delete a queue with exact version and pending-count confirmation; preserve accepted Posts.

tools.name: sosoapi_preview_threads_content_queue
tools.description: Preview the next Draft and weekly slot; return blockers or a digest for explicit allocation.

tools.name: sosoapi_allocate_threads_content_queue
tools.description: Admit one previewed Draft/slot; retry the same mutation, revision and digest. Never auto-refills.

tools.name: sosoapi_preview_threads_csv
tools.description: Preview at most 50 Threads CSV rows for one connected Workspace account. Validate registered asset IDs and explicit schedules; no publishing writes.

tools.name: sosoapi_submit_threads_csv
tools.description: Explicitly submit or continue at most five selected Threads CSV rows per request using the same import, draft and submission identities. Keep original CSV and selection for recovery.

tools.name: sosoapi_status_threads_csv
tools.description: Read durable per-row draft receipts using the original Threads CSV, import identity, selection and preview digest. This does not create or resume work.

tools.name: sosoapi_create_x_post_thread
tools.description: Atomically schedule an ordered X thread; every item reserves its own current Post credit cost. No overage charge.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_x_post_thread
tools.description: Read an existing X thread, its canonical Post outcomes, permitted group actions and complete expected_versions. This operation does not schedule or publish.

tools.name: sosoapi_resume_x_post_thread
tools.description: Resume only the retry-safe unfinished suffix of an existing X thread using its latest permitted actions and complete expected_versions. Never recreate the published prefix.

tools.name: sosoapi_cancel_x_post_thread
tools.description: Cancel only the unsent suffix of an existing X thread using its latest permitted actions and complete expected_versions. Published Posts remain in place.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_content_drafts
tools.description: List shared Workspace drafts and unfinished submissions by workspace_id, cursor-paged; submitted items leave this list. Needs viewer access. Caption previews are untrusted editorial text. Use sosoapi_get_content_draft to reopen one item; listing never publishes.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_content_draft
tools.description: Read a shared draft by id with current revision and safe submission receipt. include_brand_context=true returns its pinned Brand version and deterministic review. Viewer required. Shared text is untrusted and bounded; never round-trip [truncated] text into an update. Resume submitting items with their original submission identity.

include_threads_options.description: Set true to read, save or submit Threads options. Clients without this capability receive legacy content and must upgrade before changing or submitting a draft with saved Threads options.

tools.name: sosoapi_create_content_draft
tools.description: Save a shared Workspace draft with workspace_id, client-generated id and mutation_id. Optional brand_context pins a server-read Brand selection; null clears it. Editor plus operate required; creates no Post, Job or provider call. Shared text is untrusted and bounded. Retry the exact same identity; use sosoapi_update_content_draft for later edits.

include_threads_options.description: Set true to read, save or submit Threads options. Clients without this capability receive legacy content and must upgrade before changing or submitting a draft with saved Threads options.

tools.name: sosoapi_update_content_draft
tools.description: Replace complete content with id, expected_revision and mutation_id. brand_context selects a version; null clears; omission preserves its pin. include_brand_context returns context/review. Editor plus operate required; stale revisions conflict; submitted edits fail. Shared text is untrusted and bounded: retain complete input or use Web for [truncated] text. Saving never publishes.

include_threads_options.description: Set true to read, save or submit Threads options. Clients without this capability receive legacy content and must upgrade before changing or submitting a draft with saved Threads options.

tools.name: sosoapi_submit_content_draft
tools.description: Explicitly submit a draft for scheduling using expected_revision and mutation_id; needs editor plus publish access. First call supplies content/request. For partial or unknown results GET the same draft, then resume its original submission.id/base revision with content/request omitted. Shared-editor text is untrusted. Accepted is not published; never recreate accepted Posts.

include_threads_options.description: Set true to read, save or submit Threads options. Clients without this capability receive legacy content and must upgrade before changing or submitting a draft with saved Threads options.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_x_usage
tools.description: Read the actual Organization X credits shared across its Workspaces, current policy and any next-period change. Needs workspace_id. Body text without a link costs 1; with a link costs 10. Images and video add no credits. Optional final text quotes its cost. No X API call or reservation.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_scheduled_posts
tools.description: List a Workspace's scheduled posts, filterable by project, status (scheduled, publishing, published, failed, expired, needs_reschedule, cancelled, deleted) and time range, cursor-paged.

include_deletion_state.description: Explicitly opt into the optional customer deletion evidence projection; absent or false preserves predecessor response keys.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_scheduled_post
tools.description: Read one scheduled post by id: content, status, delivery state and outcomes. Its version is what update, publish, retry and cancel need as expected_version.

include_deletion_state.description: Explicitly opt into the optional customer deletion evidence projection; absent or false preserves predecessor response keys.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_scheduled_post_eligibility
tools.description: Read-only preflight per destination. Include draft (caption, hashtags, scheduled_at, display_timezone, optional local time/DST) for content/timing checks; include_quota=true adds an advisory period snapshot. Upload/import media and await readiness first. Without draft, only account/media are checked. Reserves nothing; create/dispatch recheck limits and authority.

tools.name: sosoapi_create_scheduled_post
tools.description: Schedule one account with provider_payload, scheduled_at and idempotency_key. X TEXT has no media; VIDEO needs one ready MP4 asset (0.5s minimum, 500 MiB maximum) and verified video permission. Media needs asset_id and canonical URL; source images use sosoapi_post_image_url. Pair local time with DST choice. Requires publish and editor role. Scheduled is not published: read its outcome.

tools.name: sosoapi_bulk_create_scheduled_posts
tools.description: Schedule posts for several accounts in one call (targets). Media needs ready uploaded/imported asset_ids and their canonical URLs. Each target succeeds or fails on its own and is reported in successes or failures. Needs the publish capability.

tools.name: sosoapi_update_scheduled_post
tools.description: Edit a scheduled post that has not been dispatched (caption, hashtags, media, link, time). Needs expected_version from the latest read; a stale version is rejected.

tools.name: sosoapi_publish_scheduled_post_now
tools.description: Publish a scheduled post immediately instead of at scheduled_at. Public and not undoable; needs expected_version. Queued is not published: read the outcome.

tools.name: sosoapi_retry_scheduled_post
tools.description: Retry a failed scheduled post, optionally at a new scheduled_at. Needs expected_version.

tools.name: sosoapi_delete_scheduled_post
tools.description: Request post deletion. Published provider content requires separate agent:delete_posts + publish grants, editor access and provider permission; old grants/API keys cannot delete it. Needs expected_version. Read terminal delete outcome.

tools.name: sosoapi_cancel_scheduled_post
tools.description: Cancel a post that has not been published. A published post is refused. Needs expected_version.

tools.name: sosoapi_withdraw_scheduled_post_delete
tools.description: Withdraw a stopped Instagram Login deletion request and retain the published post. Needs expected_version.

tools.name: sosoapi_query_threads_provider_posts
tools.description: Read one bounded official Threads post page for the selected connection. Own replies are excluded and coverage stays incomplete.

tools.name: sosoapi_query_threads_mentions
tools.description: Read one bounded official mention page where the exact connection has permission. Standard/testing access is restricted.

tools.name: sosoapi_search_threads
tools.description: Read a bounded official keyword or tag search where the exact connection has permission. Ranked results are not exhaustive and do not imply public App approval.

tools.name: sosoapi_lookup_threads_profile
tools.description: Read an eligible official public profile where the exact connection has permission. Provider follower and standard-access restrictions still apply.

tools.name: sosoapi_query_threads_own_replies
tools.description: Read one official page of own Threads replies with exact read grants; omit unproved ownership.

tools.name: sosoapi_query_threads_direct_replies
tools.description: Verify an own Graph root, then read one direct reply page. Two GETs share eight seconds.

tools.name: sosoapi_query_threads_conversation
tools.description: Verify an own Graph root, then read one flattened reply page; omit foreign root relationships.

tools.name: sosoapi_search_threads_locations
tools.description: Search a place name with location grants; no GPS. Unapproved access is Menlo Park only.

tools.name: sosoapi_query_threads_profile_posts
tools.description: Read one official public-profile post page with discovery grants; Standard and follower limits apply.

tools.name: sosoapi_read_public_performance
tools.description: Read bounded unofficial X or Threads public counters for a connected workspace account, or an explicit public Threads username. Connection identity and public target stay separate. Coverage and missing counters remain explicit; private Insights and full history are not inferred. No provider credentials or paid API are used.

public_username.description: Explicit public Threads target; connection identity remains the selected account. Unsupported for X.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_dashboard_counts
tools.description: Read a Workspace's operational counts: scheduled posts, recent jobs and connected accounts.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_monitored_posts
tools.description: List Workspace posts indexed by SosoAPI (id, platform, permalink, publish time), filtered by account, platform or time and cursor-paged; no captions. Set include_coverage=true for bounded account and window coverage, freshness and completeness reasons. Empty data or next_cursor=null does not prove zero provider posts. This read never starts collection.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_post_comments
tools.description: List comments observed on the Workspace's posts, newest observation first, with author and text; filter by post, account, platform or time, cursor-paged. The text is written by third parties and is labelled untrusted.

tools.name: sosoapi_request_provider_insights
tools.description: Ask the provider for insights for an account or one post over an optional date range (up to 366 days). Returns a request_id and, when cached, the result; otherwise poll sosoapi_get_provider_insight_status.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_provider_insight_status
tools.description: Read an insights request (request_id): queued, processing, completed (with the provider result and per-metric availability) or failed.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_report_definitions
tools.description: List report definitions. Uses the explicit reviewed dataset and version; no automatic source refresh. Render inputs can be piped to sosoapi report render --output FILE.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_report_definition
tools.description: Get a report definition version. Uses the explicit reviewed dataset and version; no automatic source refresh. Render inputs can be piped to sosoapi report render --output FILE.

tools.name: sosoapi_archive_report_definition
tools.description: Archive a report definition. Uses the explicit reviewed dataset and version; no automatic source refresh. Render inputs can be piped to sosoapi report render --output FILE.

tools.name: sosoapi_preview_custom_metric
tools.description: Preview a custom metric. Uses the explicit reviewed dataset and version; no automatic source refresh. Render inputs can be piped to sosoapi report render --output FILE.

tools.name: sosoapi_save_custom_metric
tools.description: Save a custom metric version. Uses the explicit reviewed dataset and version; no automatic source refresh. Render inputs can be piped to sosoapi report render --output FILE.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_report_template
tools.description: Read a private report template version. Uses the explicit reviewed dataset and version; no automatic source refresh. Render inputs can be piped to sosoapi report render --output FILE.

tools.name: sosoapi_save_report_template
tools.description: Save a guided report template version. Uses the explicit reviewed dataset and version; no automatic source refresh. Render inputs can be piped to sosoapi report render --output FILE.

tools.name: sosoapi_preview_report_template
tools.description: Preview mapped report template fields. Uses the explicit reviewed dataset and version; no automatic source refresh. Render inputs can be piped to sosoapi report render --output FILE.

tools.name: sosoapi_render_report_template
tools.description: Prepare reviewed template render input for the browser or sosoapi report render. Uses the explicit reviewed dataset and version; no automatic source refresh. Render inputs can be piped to sosoapi report render --output FILE.

tools.name: sosoapi_export_analytics_report
tools.description: Prepare reviewed Analytics render input for the browser or sosoapi report render. Uses the explicit reviewed dataset and version; no automatic source refresh. Render inputs can be piped to sosoapi report render --output FILE.

tools.name: sosoapi_start_instagram_oauth
tools.description: Get the provider authorize_url a human must open to connect an Instagram account. Pass workspace_id. Nothing is connected until they approve and confirm in the browser.

tools.name: sosoapi_refresh_instagram_oauth
tools.description: Refresh an Instagram connection's access token (optionally one social_account_id); reports whether it refreshed and the new expiry.

tools.name: sosoapi_start_threads_oauth
tools.description: Get the provider authorize_url a human must open to connect a Threads account. Pass workspace_id. Nothing is connected until they approve and confirm in the browser.

tools.name: sosoapi_refresh_threads_oauth
tools.description: Refresh a Threads connection's access token (optionally one social_account_id); reports whether it refreshed and the new expiry.

tools.name: sosoapi_check_threads_oauth
tools.description: Read the Threads connection's health: connected, expiry, scope and whether it can be refreshed. Pass workspace_id.

tools.name: sosoapi_start_meta_oauth
tools.description: Get the provider authorize_url a human must open to connect a Facebook Page, or Instagram through Facebook (connection_intent). Pass workspace_id. Nothing is connected until they approve and confirm in the browser.

tools.name: sosoapi_refresh_meta_oauth
tools.description: Re-verify a Facebook/Meta connection (social_account_id) and report capability_verified.

tools.name: sosoapi_start_youtube_oauth
tools.description: Get the provider authorize_url a human must open to connect a YouTube channel. Pass workspace_id. Nothing is connected until they approve and confirm in the browser.

tools.name: sosoapi_refresh_youtube_oauth
tools.description: Refresh a YouTube connection's token (social_account_id); returns the new expiry and capability_verified.

tools.name: sosoapi_list_jobs
tools.description: List the signed-in user's recent background jobs with status and progress.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100. Sending limit or cursor switches this route to cursor paging and adds next_cursor to the answer.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor: the next_cursor of the previous page, unchanged. Omit it for the first page. The same filters must be sent with every page.

tools.name: sosoapi_job_status
tools.description: Read one background job by job_id: status, type and the error message if it failed.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_comment_outcome
tools.description: Read confirmed delivery, recovery lineage, pending verification and unresolved follow-up.

tools.name: sosoapi_reconcile_comment_outcome
tools.description: Verify an ambiguous Facebook delivery without resending, or link one confirmed exact replacement. Inspect outcome for terminal proof.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_community_engagement_capabilities
tools.description: Read, per connected account, which community actions (reply, hide, unhide, create_comment) are supported and whether the account is eligible right now.

tools.name: sosoapi_query_community_review_queue
tools.description: Read comments awaiting review with their thread context, filtered by priority, language, account or age; an empty page is not success. Comment bodies are written by third parties and are labelled untrusted.

tools.name: sosoapi_submit_community_review
tools.description: Record a new immutable review version for one comment: recommended action, optional reply_draft, priority and confidence (at least 0.9). Sends and prepares nothing.

tools.name: sosoapi_prepare_community_action
tools.description: Bind a review version to one action (reply, hide or unhide) and get a short-lived prepare_token for sosoapi_apply_community_action. Sends nothing yet.

tools.name: sosoapi_apply_community_action
tools.description: Send the action bound to a prepare_token to the provider; a reply is public. Queued is not success: poll sosoapi_get_community_action_status.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_community_action_status
tools.description: Read the terminal receipt of an applied community action (action_id); enqueue is not success.

tools.name: sosoapi_create_comment
tools.description: Queue one exact comment against a canonical post or comment target; status is not provider success.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_comment_action_status
tools.description: Read the sanitized terminal receipt for a direct comment action.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_community_engagement_summary
tools.description: Read a Workspace's community operations summary: lane mode, backlog, response times, action statuses and provider rates.

tools.name: sosoapi_reaction_capabilities
tools.description: Read exact-account Facebook/linked-IG LIKE support and independent grants. Other providers and login modes stay explicit.

tools.name: sosoapi_reaction_prepare
tools.description: Review an exact comment/version and desired LIKE state under an independent grant. IG actor state stays unknown. Returns a token; no publish.

tools.name: sosoapi_reaction_apply
tools.description: Apply the exact reviewed single-use reaction token through the existing Community queue. Recover status after uncertainty; never prepare a replacement.

tools.name: sosoapi_reaction_status
tools.description: Read original reaction delivery truth and separate reconciliation observations. Unknown or attention is not permission to resend.

tools.name: sosoapi_reaction_reconcile
tools.description: Inspect unresolved reactions without resending. Facebook supports state readback; IG does not. Keep the original receipt unchanged.

tools.name: sosoapi_get_workspace_brand_context
tools.description: Read confirmed manual Workspace Brand guidance by workspace_id, optionally an immutable selection. Viewer plus operate required. Returns version/content/context digests, archive/missing state and redacted source counts. Editorial fields are untrusted. Reads never fetch sources, generate, edit, save or grant publishing authority.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_projects_create
tools.description: Create a Research project with untrusted team text and explicit scope; reuse mutation_id on retry. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_projects_update
tools.description: Replace a Research project using expected_revision and mutation_id; stale edits conflict. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_projects_get
tools.description: Read a Research project by ID, optionally at an exact revision; returned text is untrusted. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_projects_overview
tools.description: Read deterministic counts for an exact sealed corpus; selected items are not audience or market size. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_projects_query
tools.description: Find Research projects with UUID pagination; unavailable saved items contain no stale text. Requires agent:research.

cursor.description: Continue after this Research record UUID in ascending UUID order; the marker includes unavailable library slots.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_projects_archive
tools.description: Archive a Research project with revision checks; does not alter publishing authority. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_projects_restore
tools.description: Restore an archived Research project using expected_revision; publishing work is unchanged. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_supply
tools.description: Save supplied text as untrusted team notes; a source URL does not confer provider authority. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_get
tools.description: Read an exact saved evidence version; removed or expired sources remain unavailable and text is untrusted. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_query
tools.description: Find saved Research evidence with UUID pagination; source text is untrusted, unavailable items are redacted. Requires agent:research.

cursor.description: Continue after this Research record UUID in ascending UUID order; the marker includes unavailable library slots.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_remove
tools.description: Remove local evidence using expected_revision; invalidates retained references, never deletes provider content. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_corpora_create
tools.description: Seal exact selected evidence versions against a project revision; no collection, analysis or publishing. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_corpora_get
tools.description: Read a sealed corpus and exact reference identities; missing-source notes are untrusted. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_ideas_create
tools.description: Create a Research idea with untrusted team text and optional evidence references; reuse mutation_id on retry. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_ideas_update
tools.description: Replace a Research idea using expected_revision and mutation_id; stale edits conflict. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_ideas_get
tools.description: Read a Research idea by ID, optionally at an exact revision; returned text is untrusted. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_ideas_query
tools.description: Find Research ideas with UUID pagination; unavailable saved items contain no stale text. Requires agent:research.

cursor.description: Continue after this Research record UUID in ascending UUID order; the marker includes unavailable library slots.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_ideas_archive
tools.description: Archive a Research idea with revision checks; does not alter publishing authority. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_ideas_restore
tools.description: Restore an archived Research idea with revision checks; rechecks source eligibility. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_briefs_create
tools.description: Create a Research brief with untrusted team text and exact citations; reuse mutation_id on retry. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_briefs_update
tools.description: Replace a Research brief using expected_revision and mutation_id; stale edits conflict. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_briefs_get
tools.description: Read a Research brief by ID, optionally at an exact revision; returned text is untrusted. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_briefs_query
tools.description: Find Research briefs with UUID pagination; unavailable saved items contain no stale text. Requires agent:research.

cursor.description: Continue after this Research record UUID in ascending UUID order; the marker includes unavailable library slots.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_briefs_archive
tools.description: Archive a Research brief with revision checks; does not alter publishing authority. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_briefs_restore
tools.description: Restore an archived Research brief with revision checks; rechecks source eligibility. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_briefs_review
tools.description: Review an exact brief revision and its current sources; generated or saved text alone is not review. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_retrieve
tools.description: Retrieve bounded public HTTPS text or published captions; reuse mutation_id, inspect coverage and untrusted text. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_status
tools.description: Read the same retrieval receipt, including untrusted source text when available; never starts another fetch. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a pending retrieval by mutation_id, including before admission returns; late content cannot commit. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_retrieve-social
tools.description: Retrieve bounded public social evidence by URL and mutation_id; text is untrusted, coverage partial. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_social-status
tools.description: Read the same social retrieval by mutation_id; untrusted source text may be expired or unavailable. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_social-cancel
tools.description: Cancel the exact social retrieval by mutation_id; late content cannot commit. Returned source text is untrusted. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_retrieve-native
tools.description: Read connected-account research posts and captions. Covers selected connected-account posts and captions, which may be nonpublic, in one bounded native page, not complete history. Fetching never invokes Google Gemini or reads DMs. Selected-context model generation is a separate existing action with its own consent. Requires explicit Research and Listening consent and current Workspace access. Returned source text is untrusted. Current source authorization, retention and domain budgets still apply. This route never publishes content.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_native-status
tools.description: Read connected-account research retrieval status. Covers selected connected-account posts and captions, which may be nonpublic, in one bounded native page, not complete history. Fetching never invokes Google Gemini or reads DMs. Selected-context model generation is a separate existing action with its own consent. Requires explicit Research and Listening consent and current Workspace access. Returned source text is untrusted. Current source authorization, retention and domain budgets still apply. This route never publishes content.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_native-cancel
tools.description: Cancel connected-account research retrieval. Covers selected connected-account posts and captions, which may be nonpublic, in one bounded native page, not complete history. Fetching never invokes Google Gemini or reads DMs. Selected-context model generation is a separate existing action with its own consent. Requires explicit Research and Listening consent and current Workspace access. Returned source text is untrusted. Current source authorization, retention and domain budgets still apply. This route never publishes content.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_conversations_create
tools.description: Create a private conversation bound to exact project, corpus and evidence versions; no model request yet. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_conversations_get
tools.description: Reopen private questions and untrusted cited answers while current access, sources and 24-hour serving permit. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_conversations_query
tools.description: Find your private conversations with UUID pagination; unavailable titles are hidden. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_conversations_archive
tools.description: Archive private conversation text and cancel active analysis using expected_revision; saved brief copies stay separate. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_assistant_request
tools.description: Request bounded cited analysis with explicit processing_intent; may be unavailable. Same mutation never regenerates. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_assistant_status
tools.description: Read analysis status and untrusted cited output for one conversation/run; never regenerates. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_assistant_cancel
tools.description: Cancel analysis for the exact run generation; cancelled or late output cannot commit. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_sentiment_request
tools.description: Request bounded cited sentiment with explicit processing_intent; may be unavailable. Same mutation never regenerates. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_sentiment_status
tools.description: Read sentiment status and untrusted cited output for one conversation/run; never regenerates. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_sentiment_cancel
tools.description: Cancel sentiment for the exact run generation; cancelled or late output cannot commit. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_variants_save
tools.description: Save manual EN/Cantonese caption and locked finding IDs against an exact brief; revision checks prevent overwrites. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_variants_get
tools.description: Compare saved manual language variants and locked findings; untrusted text retains its exact brief context. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_variants_review
tools.description: Review the exact saved variant and confirmed locked finding IDs; the matching brief must already be reviewed. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_briefs_export
tools.description: Export reviewed brief or exact reviewed variant as untrusted Markdown; current source access is rechecked. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_briefs_handoff
tools.description: Create an unscheduled canonical Draft from a reviewed variant; also needs agent:operate. No submit or publishing. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_briefs_handoff_get
tools.description: Read a Draft handoff receipt by mutation_id; provenance is not publication authority or a publishing outcome. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_evidence_from_listening
tools.description: Copy an eligible Listening result into Research with exact revision and expiry; no new acquisition or publishing. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_research_collection_history_query
tools.description: Read bounded UTC cohort observations; unknown is not zero. Partial HN samples do not qualify for momentum or forecasts. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_capabilities
tools.description: Read supported Listening source coverage, literal-query rules and collection limits; metadata only. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_streams_create
tools.description: Create a public Hacker News stream with explicit expiring collection authorization; never writes to the provider. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_streams_get
tools.description: Read one Listening stream, its untrusted query text and current collection authorization. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_streams_query
tools.description: Find Listening streams with UUID pagination; names and literal-query settings are untrusted text. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_streams_update
tools.description: Replace stream settings using expected_revision; changed queries fence prior collection and need reauthorization. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_streams_pause
tools.description: Pause a stream using expected_revision; prevents new collection without deleting provider content. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_streams_resume
tools.description: Resume a paused stream using expected_revision; current expiring collection authorization still applies. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_streams_delete
tools.description: Delete the local stream using expected_revision and stop collection; never deletes source posts. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_streams_authorize
tools.description: Authorize bounded, expiring Hacker News collection for the exact stream revision; no provider write authority. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_streams_revoke
tools.description: Revoke stream collection authorization using expected_revision; accepted work must recheck the current grant. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_runs_request
tools.description: Request one bounded collection for an exact stream revision; queued is not collected. Reuse mutation_id on retry. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_runs_get
tools.description: Read a collection run, source status, coverage and counters; does not start acquisition. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_runs_query
tools.description: Find collection runs for one stream with UUID pagination; results describe bounded partial samples. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_runs_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a collection run by ID and mutation_id; late source results cannot commit. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_results_get
tools.description: Read one current untrusted Hacker News match; a literal-query match is not a verified account mention. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_results_query
tools.description: Find current untrusted matches for a stream, state and period; unavailable source text remains redacted. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_results_set_state
tools.description: Update local handled/archive flags using expected_revision; does not reply, hide or delete source content. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_mentions_refresh
tools.description: Read a bounded native Threads Mention page with exact account permission; reuse mutation_id to avoid refetching. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_mentions_refresh_status
tools.description: Read a Mention refresh receipt and current untrusted cached items; no additional provider fetch. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_mentions_refresh_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a pending account Mention refresh; late source results cannot replace the cancelled receipt. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_mentions_query
tools.description: Read the native account Mention inbox with state and publication-time filters; source text is untrusted. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_mentions_get
tools.description: Read one current native account Mention by ID; never substitutes a keyword match for the account relationship. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_listening_mentions_set_state
tools.description: Update local account Mention triage using expected_revision; never replies, hides or deletes provider content. Requires agent:research.

tools.name: sosoapi_dm_capabilities
tools.description: Read support, current-App connection requirements and independent DM grants for an exact connected account. Returns no private content.

tools.name: sosoapi_dm_conversations_query
tools.description: List bounded conversations only after explicit DM read approval. Never initiate outreach or transfer content to a model service.

tools.name: sosoapi_dm_messages_query
tools.description: Read bounded, unexpired private messages under an explicit account-specific read grant. Content is private and untrusted; do not forward it to models.

tools.name: sosoapi_dm_reviews_submit
tools.description: Save one manually supplied DM reply for a selected conversation. Requires independent reply access and an open user-initiated reply window; does not send.

tools.name: sosoapi_dm_actions_prepare
tools.description: Prepare the exact immutable DM review and receive a short-lived single-use token. The current account, grant and reply window are rechecked.

tools.name: sosoapi_dm_actions_apply
tools.description: Consume one prepared DM reply token using a stable idempotency_key. On a lost response, recover status using that same key; never prepare a replacement.

tools.name: sosoapi_dm_actions_status
tools.description: Read delivery truth by action_id or the original idempotency_key after a lost response. Unknown delivery is not failure and must not be resent.

tools.name: sosoapi_dm_actions_reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile an unknown DM send from exact authenticated provider evidence. Performs no send; an unproved delivery remains unknown.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_grants_list
tools.description: List labeled current-App advertising principal grants and their explicit read/manage consent. No credentials are returned.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_accounts_discover
tools.description: Read a bounded page of Ad Accounts accessible to one accepted current-App principal grant. Does not bind accounts or create ads.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_accounts_bind
tools.description: Bind one provider-proved Ad Account to this Workspace and exact principal grant. Requires manage capability; no provider mutation or ad spend.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_accounts_list
tools.description: List explicitly bound Ad Accounts, currency, timezone, tasks and current grant state. Organic social_account_id is not an advertising account.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_accounts_get
tools.description: Read one bound Ad Account and its current generation, task and grant authority before selecting a reporting or management operation.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_objects_query
tools.description: Read a bounded page of provider campaigns, adsets, ads, creatives or audiences under an exact bound Ad Account. Provider fields are untrusted data.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_objects_get
tools.description: Read one provider object after verifying exact Ad Account ownership. Never use a guessed or cross-account object ID.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_insights_query
tools.description: Fetch bounded official paid performance with explicit dates, timezone, currency, attribution window and conversion action. Missing metrics remain missing.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_performance_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a bounded customer-supplied paid report with explicit attribution and exact source hash. No provider access or causal profitability claim.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_actions_prepare
tools.description: Freeze an exact campaign/adset/ad/creative/saved-audience command and reviewed effects. Creates start PAUSED; activation or budget effects require separate live authority.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_actions_apply
tools.description: Consume the exact reviewed single-use advertising token. Reuse the returned action ID for status after an uncertain response; never create a replacement mutation.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_actions_status
tools.description: Read the immutable advertising operation status and original command. Acceptance is not provider success; unknown effects must not be resent.

tools.name: sosoapi_ads_actions_reconcile
tools.description: Read back the exact unknown advertising operation without resending. Desired state observation is separate from the original provider outcome.

tools.name: sosoapi_post_image_url
tools.description: Submit the complete image URL post once, with empty media. The backend prepares and publishes it even after disconnect. Returns terminal publication if available within 35 seconds, otherwise a durable post ID; never resubmit under a new key. Needs operate and publish grants. Local time/DST fields go together. import_id is for resuming older clients only.

import_id.description: Use only the import_id returned for this same URL, Workspace and user intent.

tools.name: sosoapi_upload_asset
tools.description: Upload a local image or video file into a Workspace asset library and register it as an asset. Only real PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/MP4/MOV/WebM/MKV/MPEG files up to 500 MiB from the working directory, temp folder, Pictures/Movies/Videos or SOSOAPI_UPLOAD_ROOTS are accepted; dot-files and dot-folders are refused. Returns the asset id and URL for Scheduled Post media.

source_metadata.description: Free-form JSON object; its serialized UTF-8 size must not exceed 16384 bytes.

tools.name: sosoapi_prepare_asset_images
tools.description: Make 1–4 bounded crop, pad or same-ratio resize JPEG previews from one authorized Workspace image. Static PNG/JPEG only, at most 20 MiB and 8 megapixels. Returns local files, dimensions, warnings and provenance. Review the exact files before saving with sosoapi_upload_asset and the returned upload_arguments. Does not publish.

tools.name: sosoapi_build_image_pdf
tools.description: Build a downloadable image-only PDF and exact JPEG page previews from 1–20 authorized Workspace PNG/JPEG images in array order. Contains without cropping; Unicode title; square, portrait or landscape pages. At most 50 MiB output. Returns local files and source provenance. Independent of LinkedIn access; does not register a PDF as an image or publish.
